result:
The decisive mistake was the Assistant's reply at step 9. The audio transcript had already failed, so the team needed a different way to get the speech into text. The Assistant had Python and shell skills, and the team had a terminal for running scripts. It could have written code that used a speech-to-text library such as Whisper or SpeechRecognition on the mp3. Instead it only described how a human could play the file and take notes, which none of the agents could do.

This set the team on a path of repeated FileSurfer retries, failed web-upload attempts and eventual replan exhaustion. The run ended with a fabricated final answer.

I judged this the most decisive point, though the Orchestrator's earlier plan and step 7 request, which assumed an agent could listen to the audio, also contributed.

AGENT: Assistant
STEP: 9
